title: Papi or Rav Papi

paragraphs: Rabbi Abba, son of Rav Pappi: [Yerushalmi Shabbat 3:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Shabbat.3.1.9). Avimi bar Pappi: [Ketubot 53a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.53a.13).
Rav Huna, son of Rav Papi: Chullin 48 (compare [Chullin 48a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.48a.4)); [Nedarim 77a](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.77a.2).

notes.text: The list preserves Papi, Rav Papi and their named sons without assuming that every patronym refers to one father.
The supplied Chullin locator is מח followed by a comma, so the translation gives folio 48 without assigning a side.

[Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3000&lang=en) also lists these patronymics and includes Rav Zuti of Rav Pappi’s school. The linked Chullin names Mar Zutra son of Rav Huna son of Rav Pappi. The linked Nedarim names Rav Zuti of Rav Pappi’s school. In Vayikra Rabbah, Chiyya son of Rabbi Pappi and Abba son of Rav Pappi occur in successive sayings.
